summary: Backend testing of current_stage filter added to /api/follow-ups/pending and /api/follow-ups/upcoming. All 18 existing tests in test_notification_bell.py pass, and 4 additional coverage tests in test_stage_filter_iter50.py (helper unit test, /upcoming filter, /pending filter transition, and null-current_stage fall-open) all pass. DB current_stage was correctly preserved and restored to 'podium' after each run.
critical_code_review_comments: _valid_stage_keys() fall-open semantics are correct: empty set is treated as 'skip filter' via the `if valid_stage_keys and stage_key not in valid_stage_keys` guard in both endpoints — no accidental bell blackout when DB has no current_stage doc.

Both /pending and /upcoming now double-load settings.current_stage in the same request path as _compute_overdue_stages() (called only for /customers/{id}/follow-ups). Not a bug, but a minor N+1 opportunity — could hoist into a request-scoped cache if perf becomes an issue.

Note: PAYMENT_STAGES ordering in utils/payment_helpers.py (podium→2nd_floor→...→handover) differs from the ordering mentioned in the problem statement (which included booking, foundation, mep, etc.). The helper implementation is agnostic to the actual list — it walks whatever PAYMENT_STAGES contains — so both variants are handled correctly, but the E1 code comment/docstring example (`podium → {booking,foundation,podium}`) is misleading vs the real data. Doesn't affect correctness.
